comparison.objective: Dry every surface and inner layer of long hair while keeping a mannequin head fixed; candidate sorts open and closed cartons on a conveyor.
comparison.physical_skill: Dryer pickup/switch operation, airflow aiming, flexible-lock exposure and thermal control versus moving rigid-carton tracking, flap-safe body grasping and no-spill transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Requires every hair patch at no more than 10% remaining water, temperature at most 50°C, fixed-head integrity, dryer off/parked and 1 s release; candidate requires reject placement with retained contents and untouched downstream passage.
comparison.reason: The tested materials, interaction physics and outcome are unrelated. The hair draft lacks task.json, a demonstrated full-task allowance and calibrated moisture/thermal parameters, but its README/task.py/scoring.py versions still establish a meaningful distinction.
